issue_request: FHIR-13098 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR Infrastructure change request for OperationOutcome asking Scope and Usage to acknowledge GuidanceResponse as an additional use context because GuidanceResponse references OperationOutcome.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies svn revision 13065. In local git history, db084c99bb4f40bbd48893ec3b4fae6d64298362 (GF#13098) added a paragraph to source/operationoutcome/operationoutcome-introduction.xml stating that OperationOutcome is referenced by GuidanceResponse and MessageHeader and noting the GuidanceResponse context.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-18500 explicitly requested removing the same manual reference paragraph. Its rationale was that GuidanceResponse uses OperationOutcome to return errors, warnings, or information about execution of a CDS operation, which was already covered by OperationOutcome scope text, and that resource references are generated elsewhere. The current source has OperationOutcome in active build scope, keeps GuidanceResponse.evaluationMessage as a Reference(OperationOutcome), and omits the removed manual paragraph. The combined branch already contains an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-18500.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-13098 on the combined branch. Re-adding GuidanceResponse-specific prose would conflict with the later FHIR-18500 decision.
